verdict.rationale: Auth0's own docs describe migrating users from an external user store or service. You can enable import mode on a custom database connection so users migrate gradually as they log in, which implies they keep their existing passwords, or you can use bulk imports. Missing for 10: competitor-specific migration guides or tooling (e.g., from Cognito/Firebase/Okta), an explicit statement or docs on importing password hashes so no resets are needed, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a reset-free migration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can follow vendor-maintained migration guides or tooling for moving off a competing auth provider without forcing password resets

citations.quote: Gradually migrate users from your external user store to Auth0 as they log in by enabling import mode on your custom database connection.
Migrate users from an existing database or service to Auth0 using bulk imports for database connections.
We've simplified the process so you can either do a bulk import or gradually migrate users as they login.
